endorsements.name: Victor Pereira
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-8020
endorsements.description: A Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation vulnerability in open-build-service allows remote attackers to store arbitrary JS code to cause XSS. This issue affects: openSUSE open-build-service versions prior to 7cc32c8e2ff7290698e101d9a80a9dc29a5500fb.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

endorsements.name: Victor Pereira
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-36777
endorsements.description: A Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision vulnerability in the login proxy of the openSUSE Build service allowed attackers to present users with a expected login form that then sends the clear text credentials to an attacker specified server. This issue affects: openSUSE Build service login-proxy-scripts versions prior to dc000cdfe9b9b715fb92195b1a57559362f689ef.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.1)

endorsements.label: CVE-2022-21948
endorsements.description: An Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in paste allows remote attackers to place Javascript into SVG files. endorsements.name: Victor Pereira
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-21949
endorsements.description: A Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in SUSE Open Build Service allows remote attackers to reference external entities in certain operations. This can be used to gain information from the server that can be abused to escalate to Admin privileges on OBS. This issue affects: SUSE Open Build Service Open Build Service versions prior to 2.10.13.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)
